R249.note: Extension allowlist plus MIME agreement and generated filenames close the upload vector, but the allowlist rejects previously accepted types (.docx, .zip, .csv), stored filenames are no longer the original name, and a 10 MB limits.fileSize cap is added without being mentioned anywhere in the write-up.

R250.note: CGI.pm escapeHTML applied to both parameters at the point of concatenation into element content; nothing else changes.

R251.note: proc_open argument array with a -- terminator removes the shell and the flag gap, but the added IP/RFC-1123 hostname check rejects hosts the original accepted (underscore names, IPv6 zone IDs, trailing-dot FQDNs), and the write-up wrongly claims system() never surfaced ping's stdout - it was echoed into the response, which the fix now silently drops.

R252.note: String-eval assert replaced by a plain === comparison and an explicit throw; the enforcement change for non-premium callers is stated plainly and is the method's documented contract.

R253.note: Argument list plus a key-format check that matches the docstring's stated contract is the right shape for a .bat target that cmd.exe re-parses; minor gap: re.match with $ still admits a single trailing newline (fullmatch or \Z would not), not exploitable here without a planted executable in the output dir.

R254.note: Does not compile: calls order.getOwnerUsername() but Order only exposes getCustomerUsername(); the intended ownership check (non-owner resolved as not-found via SecurityContextHolder) is the right shape and the write-up's claim of an upstream admin gate is wrong (controller is hasRole('USER')).

R255.note: Build fails on jdk.nashorn.api.scripting; beyond that, Nashorn's ClassFilter is documented as not a security boundary, and --no-syntax-extensions is a stated restriction that rejects previously valid tenant rules using Nashorn syntax extensions.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argument array and absolute paths closes shell and flag injection, but the geometry regex rejects valid ImageMagick geometries the original accepted (200x200!, 50%, x200) and hard-coding /usr/bin/convert breaks hosts where convert lives elsewhere; both stated.

R257.note: Injects Authentication and switches to the existing findByOwnerUsername query, matching the detail endpoint's pattern and the stated contract exactly.

R258.note: Moving username into a slog.String attribute is correct - the default handler's text path quotes any value containing control characters via strconv.AppendQuote; the log line format change is inherent and stated.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting only RestoredSession (plus String and size limits, !*) keeps the wire format and the existing IllegalArgumentException failure path; limits are stated and generous for a session record.

R260.note: Parameterized SqlCommand fed to SqlDataAdapter(SqlCommand); same query, same DataTable name and columns, region still filters.
